qualification: Support-only universal arithmetic verification; novelty unassessed.

universal_statement.parameters: All integers 0<=b<=A<L<=H, 1<=n<=L-b; odd prime p<=H with p^2>4H.
universal_statement.rows: Arbitrary p-integral P_r,D_r supported in [A,H-1],[A+1,H-1], and arbitrary p-integral gamma.
universal_statement.entries: Equation (1) of report.md, defined by the exact rational moment recurrences.
universal_statement.filter: Any p-integral (L-b)-by-n matrix; every full raw minor is also covered.
universal_statement.upper_range: For H/2<p<=H and p>b: v_p(Delta)>=-min(2n,n+R,2R+S), with R,S exactly as in report.md.
universal_statement.manuscript_specialization: For every positive N, n=48N,b=7N,A=19N,L=59N,H=65N, and every admissible odd prime.

kernel_checked_algebraic_core.scope: Algebraic core and determinant integrality, not the full arithmetic proof.

finite_tests.scope: Exact adversarial replay for N=1,2; not a universal proof.

jacobian.limitation: A finite recurrence prefix cannot prove a universal congruence.
